3344:287.name: Input/Text
3344:287.description:
A single-line input for collecting short-form information such as names, titles, email addresses, search terms, or other concise values.

WHEN TO USE
• Use when the expected value fits on one line.
• Use for short, structured, or predictable information.
• Use a text area when users may need to enter multiple lines.

USAGE GUIDELINES
• Use a persistent, descriptive label.
• Match the input type and keyboard to the expected value in implementation.
• Use placeholder text as an example only.
• Provide actionable validation feedback and preserve the entered value.
• Use leading or trailing icons only when they clarify meaning or provide a relevant action.

PROPERTIES
• State — Default, Focus, Filled, Error, or Disabled.
• Label text — Field label.
• Placeholder text — Example shown while empty.
• Hint/Error text — Supporting guidance or validation message.
• Character Count — Current and maximum character count.
• Show required — Toggles the required indicator.
• Icon — Selects the icon used in the icon slot.
• Show Character Count — Toggles the character count.
• Show hint — Toggles supporting or error text.
• Show left icon / Show right icon — Toggles leading and trailing icons.

3344:288.name: State=Default
3344:288.description:
The resting state of the text input before interaction or before a value has been provided.

WHEN TO USE
Use as the initial state when the text input is available and has no completed value.

USAGE GUIDELINES
Keep the label visible, provide only useful supporting guidance, and ensure the primary action or input affordance is clear.

3344:300.name: State=Focus
3344:300.description:
The active state shown while the text input has keyboard or pointer focus.

WHEN TO USE
Use while the user is interacting with the text input or when it is the current keyboard target.

USAGE GUIDELINES
Maintain a clear focus indicator, preserve all entered or selected content, and do not rely on color alone to communicate focus.

3344:312.name: State=Filled
3344:312.description:
The resting state of the text input after a value or valid selection has been provided.

WHEN TO USE
Use when the text input contains accepted content and is no longer focused.

USAGE GUIDELINES
Display the value or selected file clearly, keep relevant management actions available, and preserve supporting status information.

3344:324.name: State=Error
3344:324.description:
The validation state shown when the text input contains invalid, incomplete, unsupported, or failed content.

WHEN TO USE
Use after validation or processing detects a problem the user needs to resolve.

USAGE GUIDELINES
Preserve the user’s content, show a specific corrective message, associate it with the control, and do not rely on color alone.

3344:336.name: State=Disabled
3344:336.description:
The unavailable state of the text input, which cannot be focused, edited, or activated.

WHEN TO USE
Use only when the text input is temporarily unavailable or not applicable in the current context.

USAGE GUIDELINES
Preserve existing content when relevant, avoid hiding essential information in a disabled control, and explain the reason when it is not obvious.
